tagline.en: Lightricks' LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 — a distilled, fast image-to-video route with a built-in spatial upscaler.
tagline.zh: Lightricks 的 LTX-2 与 LTX-2.3——蒸馏加速的图生视频路径,内置空间超分。

en: LTX-2.x is Lightricks' newer generation of the LTX video family, covering the LTX-2 and LTX-2.3 checkpoints. It is a diffusion transformer for video generation, and in WorldFoundry the runnable route is image-to-video: you give it a starting image and it produces the clip.

The route uses a distilled schedule to keep generation fast, running two denoising stages with the official Spatial Upscaler applied between them for higher-resolution output; the upscaler is loaded automatically as part of the pipeline. It runs on WorldFoundry's native diffusion infrastructure — a shared component loader, multi-stage runner, and scheduler — rather than a third-party inference backend.
The family also advertises text-to-video and video-to-video, but in WorldFoundry those describe the upstream models; the currently runnable local variants are image-to-video only.
zh: LTX-2.x 是 Lightricks 新一代 LTX 视频家族,涵盖 LTX-2 与 LTX-2.3 两个 checkpoint。它是用于视频生成的扩散 Transformer,在 WorldFoundry 中可运行的路径是图生视频:你给它一张起始图片,它便产出片段。
该路径采用蒸馏调度以保持生成速度,运行两个去噪阶段,并在两者之间应用官方的空间超分器(Spatial Upscaler)以获得更高分辨率的输出;超分器作为 pipeline 的一部分自动加载。它运行在 WorldFoundry 的原生扩散基础设施上——共享的组件加载器、多阶段 runner 与调度器——而非第三方推理后端。
该家族也标注了文生视频与视频到视频,但在 WorldFoundry 中这些描述的是上游模型;当前本地可运行的变体仅为图生视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want fast, distilled image-to-video generation with high-resolution output from a recent, actively developed model family.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要快速、蒸馏加速的图生视频生成,并需要来自较新、活跃开发的模型家族的高分辨率输出时,可以使用它。

notFor.en: Text-to-video and video-to-video are not runnable local routes here — only image-to-video. Checkpoints are released under Lightricks' own (non-standard) license terms, so review them before production use.
notFor.zh: 这里文生视频与视频到视频并非可运行的本地路径——仅支持图生视频。Checkpoint 采用 Lightricks 自有(非标准)许可条款,正式使用前请自行确认。
